original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.

Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: Narrow the characteristic-four unsigned connector floor interval from 9 <= N(4) <= 20 to 9 <= N(4) <= 17 by a cube-union and triple-class proof with axis-deletion residual cases. Prove the sharp five-source depth-two coverage maximum 28 of 31 nonzero masks, classify all four maximizing words up to source relabelling, and provide an eight-inventory all-ones search normalization.
scope_change_reason: The question targets exact N(4). The alphabet stays fixed and the source count changes, a scope-change trigger on the original card. This proof limits batch sizes for any characteristic-four floor consumer.
bottleneck_link: Side result about the complete-call interface floor; no physical consumer or kappa change is supplied.
stop_rule: At the research checkpoint, publish the strongest independently checked bound or construction. Do not claim a general ten-source exclusion from a restricted search.
evidence: Written translated-cube/outside-component proof, all 76 parity-duplicate cases, exhaustive small translated-cube controls and separately written literal component checks. Complete canonical depth-two censuses at thresholds 30 and 29 account for 2,546,168,625 words, find zero and four solutions respectively, and agree with an independent C engine. Standard-library replay validates every maximizer and compares pruning with unpruned small cases. All 35 gap inventories are enumerated, leaving eight types and 19,448 type-count vectors at k=10. A 72-event eighteen-source witness attains the cube cap H(18,0)=22 with no parity-prefix duplicates; it is a finite sharpness witness, not a floor word. The stronger eighteen-source triple-class count excludes all repeat cases except r=2,4,5; axis deletions and conservative nonattainment bounds exclude all six residual branches, yielding N(4)<=17.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
